description: This file defines a custom adapter for a RecyclerView in an Android application. It manages a dataset of strings, creates ViewHolders, binds data to views, and handles item clicks.

classes.name: CustomAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter subclass that manages string data for display in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: CustomAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: A custom ViewHolder class holding a reference to a TextView and handling click events.

methods.name: CustomAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dataset with a string array.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder, inflating the layout for a row item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder's TextView for the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the dataset.

methods.name: ViewHolder
methods.description: A static inner class that holds a reference to a TextView and sets a click listener.

methods.name: getTextView
methods.description: Returns the TextView managed by the ViewHolder.
